title: Molecule OCR Real images Dataset
description: Test dataset from paper Image2SMILES: Transformer-based Molecular Optical Recognition Engine. The dataset contains 296 structures: images and Functional Groups SMILES (FG-SMILES). The structures were extracted from 24 papers, which were selected from each volume of Journal of Organic Chemistry (2020).
